# @surfaces-ui/pipelines-dbt

A dbt project as a Surfaces UI pipeline: datasets, tests, runs and semantic models read from dbt's artifacts, with dbt build only on a person's approval.

A dbt project as a pipeline: datasets, tests, runs and semantic models read from dbt's artifacts. dbt alone builds, and only when a person asks.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/pipelines-dbt
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.

Every Surfaces UI package is released at the same version; install them all at that one version, since mixing releases is not supported.
